data.title: UNEA Resolution - 'End Plastic Pollution' - and IUCN role in implementation of the Treaty | IUCN
data.description: The new UNEA Resolution, 'End Plastic Pollution: Towards a legally binding instrument', establishes an Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee that will develop the specific content of the new plastic pollution treaty with the aim of completing its work by the end of 2024. The future is ours to improve, and this news from UNEA provides a strong message of hope that we can indeed eliminate plastic pollution from our environment with a multi-pronged approach and international cooperation.
